notes.title: new minor update
notes.notes:
new minor update for District Panic! Here’s what’s new:
- Fixed some spelling mistakes.
- Corrected and switched the Upgrade and Downgrade tooltips.
- Lowered Level 1 difficulty.
- Environmental blades and lasers now damage loot boxes.
- You can now close the music player using the ESC button on the keyboard.


Thanks for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
New Audio Player:
Always accessible for quick access to game songs.
Select songs and switch playlists to your favorites.
Customize the appearance of the audio player to your preference.

Mini-Game in Audio Player:
A new mini-game added to the audio player, allowing you to chill while listening to your favorite tracks.

Performance Optimization:
Significant optimizations for improved performance, especially on low-end devices.
Additional fixes are currently in progress to further enhance gameplay performance.

Audio System Overhaul:
The entire audio system has been revamped for a better listening experience.
Dropped the old tool and implemented a new one(we built) to seamlessly fade in and out audio.
Improved sound effects for a richer and more immersive experience.

New Enemy: DrBugfix:
Introducing "DrBugfix," a new stationary healing enemy.
DrBugfix heals other enemies and has a spinning personal shield for protection.

Weapon Toxic Area Fix:
The weapon toxic area has been fixed to work better with your range and damage, providing a more balanced gameplay experience.

Homing Missile Performance:
Homing missile performance has been significantly improved and optimized.

Crash Fixes on Older Computers:
Fixed several crashing issues on older computers to ensure a smoother experience for all players.

Controller Vibration Control:
Added the ability to stop vibration on the controller for a more customizable gameplay experience.

Skill Tree Descriptions:
Added missing descriptions on the skill tree for better clarity.

UI Behavior Fixes:
Fixed various UI behavior issues for a smoother user experience.

Reset Settings Option:
Added a reset settings option in the settings menu to easily revert to default settings.

New Tutorial:
A comprehensive tutorial has been added to teach new players the game mechanics from the first time they start the game.

English Spelling Corrections:
Fixed several spelling mistakes in the English language to improve readability.

Input Method Indicators:
Added prompt indicators for the control method you are using, whether it's a keyboard or controller.

Experience these new features and improvements in the latest update of District Panic. Your feedback is crucial for helping me refine and enhance the game. Enjoy the new audio experience, have fun with the mini-game, and watch out for DrBugfix!
